locator.title: Грудное вскармливание без стресса: что нужно знать маме
locator.lead: Развеиваем мифы о грудном вскармливании и знакомим с комплексом Фемибион®

nearest_text_after.text: Развеиваем мифы о грудном вскармливании и знакомим с комплексом Фемибион®

image_reading: Close-up of two baby bottles with transparent silicone nipples, the front bottle sharply in focus and the second softly blurred behind it.
A warm red blurred background and shallow depth of field leave the bottle nipples as the clear focal point.
Visible highlights on the transparent plastic can move naturally without changing the objects or composition.
analysis.article_context: Cover image for an article that calmly dispels breastfeeding myths and frames informed support for mothers; the bottles suggest prepared, practical feeding care without depicting a mother or baby.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Calm, attentive preparation supports a mother navigating breastfeeding information without stress.
structured_intent.primary_action: A soft reflection travels across the front baby bottle and settles.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The front bottle's transparent nipple holds a gentle settled highlight in the last frame.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The bottles remain a quiet, reassuring symbol of practical infant-feeding care throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep the close-up camera fixed on the front bottle. A gentle reflection begins along one side of its clear nipple, travels gradually across the collar, and softly settles near the center; the rear bottle receives only a subdued delayed shimmer. The settled highlight is clearly visible in the final moments.
models.positive_prompt: A soft reflection slowly glides across the front bottle's clear nipple and collar, with a faint matching shimmer on the bottle behind. Fixed close-up camera. By the final frame, the front nipple holds a calm, settled highlight.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, retain the locked close-up. Let a warm optical highlight smoothly progress across the transparent front nipple and collar for most of the duration, with subtle related light catching the out-of-focus bottle behind. It resolves into one calm stable highlight on the front bottle near the end.
models.positive_prompt: A warm soft reflection travels slowly over the front bottle nipple and collar, then settles into a gentle clear highlight on the front bottle by the end. Fixed camera; a faint shimmer follows on the rear bottle.

models.scene_plan: In the four-second fixed close-up, introduce a small warm reflection on the front nipple immediately and move it evenly across the clear plastic and collar. A restrained shimmer appears on the blurred bottle behind as secondary motion. The reflection comes to rest as a distinct gentle highlight on the front nipple at the endpoint.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed close-up: a soft warm highlight glides across the front bottle's clear nipple and collar, lightly catching the rear bottle. It settles as a calm visible highlight on the front nipple in the last frame.
